name: opencode-for-copilot
displayName: Opencode Terminal for VS Code Copilot
description: Bridge a local opencode v2 server into VS Code Copilot Chat as provider OCT. Opt-in; 1 conversation = 1 opencode session; Copilot tool bridge with approval confirmations.

oct.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the OCT provider (local opencode v2 engine in Copilot Chat). Runs `opencode serve` in the background. Requires a window reload after changing.

oct.opencodeUrl.markdownDescription: Optional external opencode server URL (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). Empty = the extension spawns and manages its own `opencode serve`. Requires a window reload after changing.

oct.opencodeBinary.markdownDescription: Path or command name of the opencode v2 binary used for `--version` checks and managed `serve`. Requires a window reload after changing.

oct.opencodePassword.markdownDescription: Optional password for the opencode server (sent as HTTP Basic `opencode:<password>`). Empty = no auth header. Prefer the `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD` environment variable; this setting is a fallback.

oct.permissionTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: No-answer timeout (ms) for engine approval confirmations. Past the timeout the request is denied (default-deny). Requires a window reload after changing.

oct.callbackToken.markdownDescription: Stable token for the tool-bridge callback (external-mode servers only). Empty = a random per-window token (managed mode). Set this when you manually install the bridge plugin on an external server, and export the same value as OCT_CALLBACK_TOKEN there. Requires a window reload after changing.
